description: Show how one MBS item's descriptor and schedule fee changed across the schedule releases held here, newest first. Use it to answer what an item paid or said on an earlier date. Only the releases ingested are listed; it is not a complete history of the item.

item_number.description: An MBS item number, 1 to 6 digits, for example 30445.

title: Get item history
